touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Welshpool qualifies as a local detour through Powysland Museum and Severn Farm Pond. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Welshpool: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Welshpool offers Powysland Museum, Severn Farm Pond, Domen Castell Mound and Bailey Castle within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
